instruction: Query osquery for all opened ports with associated process names
output: SELECT DISTINCT p.name, lp.port, lp.protocol FROM processes p JOIN listening_ports lp ON p.pid = lp.pid;

instruction: Query osquery for number of processes per user
output: SELECT uid, COUNT(*) AS proc_count FROM processes GROUP BY uid ORDER BY proc_count DESC;
